    1. capableOnEvent(EventType, EventPayload)

Interface CapableEventListener<T>

Type Parameters:
T - The type of value returned by capableOnEvent(EventType, EventPayload) and expected by the consuming CapableEventEmitter.
All Superinterfaces:
EventListener
All Known Implementing Classes:
PointReferenceConstraintChecker
public interface CapableEventListener<T> extends EventListener
A specialization of an EventListener that is capable of returning a value when handling an event.

Unlike a generic EventListener whose EventListener.onEvent(EventType, EventPayload) method has a void return type, a CapableEventListener computes and returns a result of type T via capableOnEvent(EventType, EventPayload).

This return value is specifically listened for and consumed by a CapableEventEmitter using CapableEventEmitter.capableBroadcast(EventType, EventPayload). If the returned value matches the runtime type expected by the emitter's typeToken, the broadcast returns early with both this listener and the returned result.

Lehlogonolo Poole

  • Method Details

    • capableOnEvent

      <K> T capableOnEvent(EventType event, EventPayload<K> properties)
      Handles an incoming event and computes a return value of type T.

      Invoked by CapableEventEmitter.capableBroadcast(EventType, EventPayload). If the returned object is an instance of the emitter's bound type, the emitter terminates its broadcast early and returns this result.

      Type Parameters:
      K - The type of the object held by the EventPayload.
      Parameters:
      event - The type of event being broadcast.
      properties - The payload containing properties and data for the event.
      Returns:
      A value of type T produced in response to the event, or null if no meaningful value could be generated.
